policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina MFA's current Albania page expressly exempts holders of valid Albanian ordinary passports for up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: Use a valid Albanian ordinary passport for entry, exit, transit or a stay of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Work, residence, diplomatic, service, seafarer and other travel-document routes remain outside this ordinary-passport visitor baseline.
Meet ordinary border, purpose, funds and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: Kosovo visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Kosovo's official short-stay visa list expressly includes Albania among countries not requiring visas; it also permits Albanian citizens to enter with a biometric identity card.
conditions: This ordinary Albanian-passport baseline is visa-free for a short visit; Kosovo separately permits Albanian citizens to use a valid biometric ID card.
Stay is limited to 90 days in a 180-day period; employment, residence, special travel documents and final admission are separate.
A visa or residence permit is required where Kosovo law requires one for the traveller's purpose or circumstances.

policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's official tourist guidance makes a tourist visa mandatory for non-residents other than the named Chinese-national exception and offers electronic tourist-visa issuance online.
conditions: Use an Albanian ordinary passport for a tourist visit. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; an Albanian non-resident therefore needs the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel. Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration does not replace the tourist visa.
The tourist visa is single-entry up to 90 days, potentially extendable once for 90 days; work, residence, transit and final admission are separate.

application.label: Cuba electronic tourist visa
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Albanian ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.

policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 F5A service makes an online tourism eVisa available to citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email.
conditions: Use a valid Albanian ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket, hotel or host evidence and sufficient funds. F5A is tourism only, single-entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. The visa certificate is emailed, so this is electronic issuance rather than online preapproval followed by border issuance.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online using the Albanian ordinary passport and upload the tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's live Government announcement confirms its named online-visa portal is available to all interested visitors; that portal accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the resulting eVisa electronically before travel.
conditions: Apply using the Albanian ordinary passport that will be used for travel; the current portal excludes other travel documents and requires a passport valid at least 30 days from arrival with a blank page.
Register, upload the stated visitor documents, pay online, and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, duration, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea Government-announced eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application using the Albanian ordinary passport.
Upload supporting documents and pay online.
Receive and carry the eVisa PDF issued by email before travel.
